description: Embeds one immutable image object with MediaWiki-native file presentation and archive provenance.

parameters.name: sha256
parameters.label: Object SHA-256
parameters.description: Exact lowercase SHA-256 of the archived image object.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.label: Source filename
parameters.description: Exact source-record filename for this occurrence; verified against the archived object and used for filename-derived alternative text.

parameters.name: align
parameters.label: Alignment
parameters.description: Optional MediaWiki horizontal alignment; any explicit value uses block presentation, none requests an un-floated block, and omission keeps an unframed image inline.

parameters.name: caption
parameters.label: Caption
parameters.description: Optional wikitext caption. Block or framed presentation displays it; inline presentation uses its plain text as the file-link title and fallback alternative text.

parameters.name: alt
parameters.label: Alternative text
parameters.description: Alternative text; omission or an empty non-decorative value derives accessible text from the filename.

parameters.name: decorative
parameters.label: Decorative
parameters.description: Set to yes only for an evidenced decorative image; then leave alt empty.

parameters.name: width
parameters.label: Width
parameters.description: Optional displayed width or bounding width in pixels, from 1 to 4096.

parameters.name: height
parameters.label: Height
parameters.description: Optional displayed height or bounding height in pixels, from 1 to 4096.

documentation_wikitext:
{{SHORTDESC:Embed a content-addressed image from PreservationArchive}}
Use this source-neutral template for an immutable image object already published by PreservationArchive. Preserve source frame, alignment, caption, and dimension semantics. Block or framed captions render visibly; inline captions supply the file-link title and fallback alt text. Omitted alt text otherwise follows MediaWiki's filename-derived fallback; decorative output requires explicit evidence. Display bounds preserve intrinsic aspect ratio, with thumbnail and frameless modes capped at intrinsic size.

examples.invocation:
{{Preservation image
| site = example-site
| sha256 = 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
| filename = Diagram sample.png
| frame = thumb
| align = left
| caption = Diagram with an ''emphasized'' caption.
| width = 320
}}
examples.description: An archived thumbnail with native alignment, parsed caption wikitext, filename-derived alt text, and a bounded display width.
